title: Bentness of the complete quadratic function
statement: Let $n$ be even. The real sign-valued function obtained by encoding the complete quadratic form $\sum_{i<j}x_i x_j$ over $\mathbb F_2$ is bent on the $n$-dimensional binary cube: every Fourier coefficient has absolute value $2^{-n/2}$.
